arabic text: YAA HUSAIN BE WATAN YAA HUSAIN BE KAFAN\nGANJE SHAHIDAAN LAASHE HI LAASHE\nJALTE KHAIME YAA HUSAIN
english translation text: O Hussain, without a homeland; O Hussain, without a shroud.\nIn the field of the martyrs there are bodies everywhere;\nthe tents are burning—O Hussain.

arabic text:
SINA-E-AKBAR HALQE ASGHAR QAASIM KAA
PAAMAAL BADAN HAI
BAALI SAKINAA ASHQ BAHAAE BE CHAADAR MAZLOOM
BAHEN HAI
KHUN FISHAAN NAZRON SE DEKHE AISE MANZAR YAA
HUSAIN
english translation text:
Akbar’s chest, Asghar’s throat, and Qasim’s
trampled body lie there.
Young Sakina sheds tears, and the oppressed sister
stands without her veil.
With blood-filled eyes she looks upon these scenes—
O Hussain.

arabic text:
BEHTAA DARIYAA PYAASE BACHE KISKAA RASTAA
DEKH RAHE HAIN
MASHQO ALAM HAI ZAKHMI ZAKHMI GHAAZI DARIYAA
PAR SOTE HAI
DUB GAYAA APNE HI KHUN ME TERAA LASHKAR YAA
HUSAIN
english translation text:
The river flows while the thirsty children
wait for someone to return.
The water-skin and standard are wounded; wounded Ghazi
lies asleep beside the river.
Your army has drowned in its own blood—
O Hussain.

arabic text:
EK ZAIFAA DASHTE BALAA ME AAYI HAI FARIYAAD
SUNAANE
JISKO CHAKKI PEES KE PAALAA KEHTI HAI KOI TO
BATAALE
KEHTI HAI AAJAA MERE DILBAR AAGAYI MAADAR YAA
HUSAIN
english translation text:
An elderly mother has come to the desert of tribulation
to voice her plea.
She who raised him by grinding grain asks,
‘Will someone tell me where he is?’
She cries, ‘Come, my beloved—your mother has arrived’—
O Hussain.

arabic text:
EK BAHEN KHAIME KE DAR PAR DEKH RAHI HAI
DARD KAA MANZAR
KEHTI HAI BEGORO KAFAN PAR KAISE DAALU HAAYE
CHAADAR
english translation text:
A sister stands at the tent’s entrance,
looking upon the painful scene.
She says, ‘How can I cover my brother
when he lies without grave or shroud?’

arabic text: CHHINGAYI CHAADAR MARGAYI KHWAAHAR KYUN NA\nTADAPKAR YAA HUSAIN
english translation text: When her veil was snatched away, the sister died of anguish—\nwhy would she not writhe in pain? O Hussain.

arabic text:
ZAKHMI KAANON WAALI BACHI HAATH RAKHE HAIN
RUKHSAARON PAR
DOD RAHI HAI MAQTAL MAQTAL LOUT RAHI HAI
ANGAARON PAR
DHUNDH RAHI HAI BAAP KAA SINAA KEHTI HAI ROKAR
YAA HUSAIN
english translation text:
The little girl with wounded ears holds her hands
against her cheeks.
She runs through the battlefield, stumbling
over burning embers.
Searching for her father’s chest, she cries—
O Hussain.

arabic text:
NOUKE SINAA PAR AAP KAA SAR HAI SAANIE ZEHRAA
BE CHAADAR HAI
KOTHON PAR HAI BHID UDOO KI SAB KE HAATHON ME
PATHAR HAI
KHUN KE AANSU KYUN NA ROE NEZE PE SAR YAA
HUSAIN
english translation text:
Your head is upon the spear, while the second Zahra
stands unveiled.
Crowds of enemies fill the rooftops,
with stones in every hand.
Why would the head upon the spear not weep tears of blood—
O Hussain?

arabic text:
QALBE MUSAYYAB NAUHAA KUNAA HAI SHAAMIL HAI
RAIHAAN KE AANSU
NAATIKE QUR’AAN QATL HUWAA HAI BEHTE HAI
QUR’AAN KE AANSU
PYAAS PE TERI NAUHAA KUNAA HAI MOUJE KAUSAR
YAA HUSAIN
english translation text:
Musayyab’s heart laments, and Raihan’s
tears join it; the speaking
Qur’an has been slain, and
the Qur’an itself sheds tears.
Even the waves of Kawthar
lament your thirst— O Hussain.
